coverageLimits.readThisFirst: This artifact is NOT 'all six invariants verified offline'. Of the six MAIN invariants, 21 / 55 / 55 / 0 (component hex ids) are provable here; part=8 and netflag=13 are only RECONSTRUCTED (Designator-based, not componentType); pages=2 is NOT provable at all. And the source is also t53's own baseline, so using it to verify t53 is self-reference.
coverageLimits.headlineRisk: CIRCULARITY, stated first because it limits every number below: docs/evidence/current/t31-dataset.json is exactly the baseline that t53-verify-main.mjs compares the live document against. Reading it offline re-states the pinned expectation. It can prove 'the baseline file still contains these numbers and has these bytes'; it CANNOT prove 'the live canvas still equals the baseline'. Calling that an offline verification of MAIN would be self-reference, not verification.

items.why: the source records 18 page records, not 2. The two numbers are different objects: 18 is the page-record list inside t31-dataset.json, while 2 is both the t53 --pages default and the length of main-restore-verify.pages. No offline arithmetic turns 18 into 2.
items.note: further: page ids re-register. t31 records P1 as 03feee84..., main-restore-verify records P1 as d224f8d1..., so even the two historical values are not the same object.

items.status: OFFLINE RECONSTRUCTION ONLY - not a proof
items.why: t31-dataset.json stores no componentType, so the split cannot be measured from this source. 8 is reconstructed as 'components with a non-empty Designator' (u1..u7 plus layout:flag:_3V3:bus:240 with Designator 'U?'); 13 is reconstructed as the remainder. Both happen to equal the latest reported split, but a proxy that agrees is not a measurement.
items.whatIsMissing: a component export that stores componentType (the live sch_PrimitiveComponent.getAll returns it; the committed export never stored it)

negativeControl.why: +3V3 is a PART whose id is layout:flag:_3V3:bus:240 and whose name is '+3V3'; a name-based rule counts it as a netflag and over-reports by 1. This is the exact trap that makes 'count the flags by name' wrong.

coverageLimits.ceiling: t53 requires the bridge. While the bridge is unavailable, THIS GRADING IS THE ACHIEVABLE CEILING: 21 / 55 / 55 / 0 provable offline; 8 / 13 reconstructible offline but unproven; 2 unprovable offline.

The only thing an offline read proves is that the baseline file itself still contains these numbers and that its bytes are these bytes.
